description: Motorboating teaches safe operation of a motorboat: hazards and first aid, life jackets and the swimmer test, engines and fueling, boating laws and required equipment, navigation rules, and handling, anchoring and docking a boat.

safety.note: Motorboating follows Safety Afloat with a qualified supervisor; pass the swimmer test and wear a life jacket.

outlineNote: Excerpts showed the topics (hazards and first aid, the swimmer test and life jackets, engines and fuel, Safety Afloat and boating laws, required equipment, navigation lights and signals, and boat handling and knots) but not their numbering, so no requirement outline is published yet.
